method: Unedited screenshots of the current public application in a fresh temporary browser profile. Only the retained fictional shipment case was imported. Ordinary Download Excel, Upload Excel, Review workbook changes and Apply inputs controls were used. One literal workbook value was changed. No UI labels, controls or results were injected; no shared publication occurred.
actions: In Collections, import earliest-arrival-shipment.app-case.json using Import app, workflow or case.
Choose Both, then Download Excel to obtain this case’s workbook.
In Parameters, change L2 (Parameters expense Limit) from 650000 to 500000; leave M2 (cash limit) and every other value unchanged.
Choose Upload Excel. Review workbook changes shows one changed value and no added or removed values.
Choose Apply inputs, then wait for Reports current and Saved locally.
Choose Reports, then Decision. Direct is preferred at 400000 USD cents; backup is blocked at 600000 with one failed check.
Export case and verify the exact immutable app package, unchanged module and only expenseLimit changed in case inputs.
Import the retained unchanged downloadable exercise case in a separate fresh context and verify direct is preferred again.
